name: cable side plank row v. 3
description: A side plank held while you row a cable. It trains the core, shoulders and back at the same time.
instructions: Set up in a side plank with a low cable handle in your top hand.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Row the handle toward your ribs.
Keep your hips high and stable.
Extend slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
